findings.passage: By November 2017 he said he had talked to West "just to tell him, like, he's my brother. I love Kanye."
findings.problem: The West thread, which is one of the two main tests of the 'family is the line' argument ("Personal attacks were survivable. Family was not."), stops at a 2017 reconciliation. The record has since tested that exact line. In March 2025 West posted, then deleted, derogatory remarks about Jay-Z and Beyonce's twins on X. In April 2025 he gave a partial apology framed around feeling abandoned by Jay-Z (widely reported, e.g. tribune.com.pk/story/2535434 and theprint.in/feature/.../2587334). The evidence record has no claim, source or review trigger for this. A reader now, or in five years, who knows the 2025 episode will read 'I love Kanye' as the endpoint of the relationship and see the profile as stale on its own central test. C12 and C53 are marked stable with no review trigger, even though the relationship has kept changing.
findings.acceptance_test: The section dates the 2017 endpoint as a point in time, not a resolution. Research opens a reliable source on the March 2025 posts and records what Jay-Z himself did or said publicly (including silence), keeping it separate from anonymous 'source says' reports of legal action. The draft then either uses the episode as a further test of the family boundary or states why it is left out. The episode is recorded as a claim with a source ID. C12/C53, or a new claim, is marked time_sensitive with a review trigger for any later public statement by Jay-Z about West.

findings.problem: The meta description states the refusal with no date. After February 14, 2027, when the October 26, 2026 announcement says he will headline Super Bowl LXI, a search snippet saying he 'turned down the Super Bowl' will read as wrong or out of date to most searchers. Search results show this text with none of the body's context. C92 is marked stable with no review trigger, so nothing in the record will bring it back for revision. The body handles the reversal well. The metadata does not.
findings.acceptance_test: The description dates the refusal (e.g. 'In 2019 Jay-Z refused the halftime show because it felt like an audition...') or covers the arc of refusing it and later headlining on his company's stage, and stays within 120–170 characters. C92 is reclassified time_sensitive with a 2027-02-14 trigger to recheck the title, meta_title, persona_title, description and the halftime FAQ together.

assessment: Five-year test: the thesis largely passes. The hook is the dated 2019 press conference. The main discriminator rests on self-reports from 2009, 2017 and 2018. The 2026 halftime announcement is treated as an open question dated to 2026-11-06, not as proof, so the central insight survives without it. The Forbes figure, the Buzbee dismissal and the Rivera dispute all carry absolute dates, and C16, C90 and C19 have workable triggers. Durability gaps: (1) the West relationship, a main test of the family boundary, stops at the 2017 'I love Kanye' while the March 2025 attack on his children directly tests that line and is not in the record; (2) the undated meta description, 'turned down the Super Bowl', will read as wrong after the February 14, 2027 show and has no trigger; (3) several present-tense or 'stable' dependencies (Roc Nation producing the show, never selling his masters, the unopened-sources note) need dated phrasing or time_sensitive triggers. Similarity advisory: the only tripped pair (0.058, Nara Smith) shares 'the Eight read(ing)', which is ordinary type vocabulary. The arguments being made are different, so this is not reuse. Sensitive-allegation and contested-typing risks remain.
